description: The headquarters sends out a parked supply hauler (a gatherer, KindOf HARVESTER) every 20 s, 170 units from the base: seen gatherers away from the base for the economic raids and the worker protection.

edits.replace:
Behavior = OCLUpdate ModuleTag_Haulers
    OCL = OCL_IronwoodHauler
    MinDelay = 20000
    MaxDelay = 20000
  End
  Behavior = AutoDepositUpdate ModuleTag_Income

edits.append:
; Bench overlay: a parked supply hauler (gatherer without a supply system), spawned by the headquarters.
Object IronwoodHauler
  Scale = 1.0
  Side = Ironwood
  EditorSorting = VEHICLE
  DisplayName = OBJECT:IronwoodWorker
  Draw = W3DModelDraw ModuleTag_Draw
    OkToChangeModelColor = Yes
    DefaultConditionState
      Model = iw_worker
    End
  End
  KindOf = SELECTABLE VEHICLE HARVESTER
  Body = ActiveBody ModuleTag_Body
    MaxHealth = 160.0
    InitialHealth = 160.0
  End
  ArmorSet
    Conditions = None
    Armor = IronwoodVehicleArmor
    DamageFX = None
  End
  Behavior = AIUpdateInterface ModuleTag_AI
  End
  Behavior = LifetimeUpdate ModuleTag_Life
    MinLifetime = 90000
    MaxLifetime = 90000
  End
  Behavior = DestroyDie ModuleTag_Destroy
  End
  Behavior = FXListDie ModuleTag_DeathFX
    DeathFX = FX_StarterVehicleDie
  End
  Locomotor = SET_NORMAL IronwoodWorkerLocomotor
  VisionRange = 100.0
  ShroudClearingRange = 140.0
  RadarPriority = UNIT
  BuildCost = 400
  Geometry = CYLINDER
  GeometryMajorRadius = 6.0
  GeometryMinorRadius = 6.0
  GeometryHeight = 12.0
  GeometryIsSmall = Yes
  WeaponSet
    Conditions = None
  End
  Behavior = PhysicsBehavior ModuleTag_Physics
  End
End

; Bench overlay: the headquarters sends out a hauler now and then.
ObjectCreationList OCL_IronwoodHauler
  CreateObject
    ObjectNames = IronwoodHauler
    Count = 1
    Offset = X:170 Y:60 Z:0
    Disposition = ON_GROUND_ALIGNED
  End
End
